title: BisectState
description: Schema for bisect search state (bisect/state.json), enables mid-search resume

lo.description: Current lower bound index (inclusive) in the commit array

hi.description: Current upper bound index (inclusive) in the commit array

commits_total.description: Total number of commits in the search range

tested.description: List of commits tested so far with their bisect verdicts

skip_count.description: Number of SKIP verdicts encountered so far

confirmed_first_bad_index.description: Index in commit array of the confirmed first-bad commit, or null if not yet confirmed
